name: Storytelling and persuasion
summary: Tell one customer story three ways: 60 seconds, 3 minutes, and the boardroom version.
repBrief: Tell the Harbourline Logistics story (see the product facts) three times. First the 60-second version, then the 3-minute version when asked, then the boardroom version for executives. Keep every fact true.
buyerBrief: You asked the rep to tell you about a customer like you. First ask for 'the short version'. Then ask for more detail. Then say: 'Now give it to me the way you would tell my board.' React honestly: lean in when it is concrete, interrupt when it is abstract or sounds made up.
winCondition: The buyer says they want to share the story with someone else or asks for a next step.
